package.description: LEM 10 is a control and analysis package for Lode ergometers, aimed at medical and research professionals.

en-US.author: Lode B.V.
en-US.description: LEM 10 is a control and analysis package for Lode ergometers, aimed at medical and research professionals.
en-US.longDescription:
The Lode Ergometry Manager - LEM 10 (LEM) stands as an indispensable software package tailored to medical professionals, designed for the seamless control of Lode ergometers and the precise monitoring of ergometric parameters in test subjects. This sophisticated software equips operators with a versatile set of tools, enabling them to program protocols, exercise precise control over ergometers, visualize data, securely save and perform in-depth analysis of ergometry results, and generate customized PDF reports.
LEM offers versatile data presentation, featuring customizable widgets and a test or athlete-specific screen. Database management: store and organize participant information and test data, supporting multiple databases for different users. Device management: connect the various Lode devices from the sports medicine and rehabilitation segments to LEM, with the ability to switch between devices within a single LEM setup.
LEM 10 is compatible with LEM 6, 7, 8 and 9. This means that the database of these versions can be imported and used in LEM 10.
en-US.name: Lode Ergometry Manager 10

zh-CN.description: LEM 10 是面向医疗与科研人员、用于控制 Lode 功率自行车并进行数据分析的软件套件。
zh-CN.longDescription:
Lode Ergometry Manager - LEM 10（LEM）是一款专为医疗专业人员设计的软件套件，用于无缝控制 Lode 功率自行车，并对受试者的运动测试参数进行精确监测。该软件为操作人员提供了功能丰富的工具，可用于编写测试方案、精确控制功率自行车、可视化数据、安全保存测试结果并开展深入分析，还可生成自定义 PDF 报告。
LEM 提供多样化的数据展示方式，支持可自定义的控件以及与测试或运动员相关的专属界面。数据库管理：存储并整理受试者信息与测试数据，支持面向不同用户的多个数据库。设备管理：将运动医学与康复领域的各类 Lode 设备连接至 LEM，并可在同一 LEM 配置中切换设备。
LEM 10 兼容 LEM 6、7、8 和 9，这些版本中的数据库可以导入 LEM 10 继续使用。
